links.comparator_used: Unadjusted AI autocontouring of seminal vesicles, with manual contouring as the Dunnett's test reference group
links.outcome: PTV and CTV dose coverage (Dmax, Dmin, Dmean, D95, D98, D99, V95%)
links.effect: CTV Dmean vs manual contouring: unadjusted AC -58.7 cGy (95% CI -123.0 to 5.5, p = 0.077, g = 0.78); slice-adjusted AC -41.3 cGy (p = 0.254, g = 0.63). PTV Dmean unadjusted AC -92.8 cGy (p = 0.075, g = 0.67). Dose differences <1% of prescription. No significant differences in any DVH parameter.
links.quote: No statistically significant differences were observed among the three groups in any dose volume histogram parameters.

design_hint: clinician slice-range adjustment of AI autocontours
